answer: Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 66 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. Because the vault deposit is held in the cipher escrow, the crystal audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases therefore burns capital on every one it does not finish. That is 28 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
